page.layout: One column of running text; marginal notes in the right margin, beside the first and third paragraphs. Running head at top, page number at top right, signature at foot centre.

main_text.p: iunt; ante omnia operam esse dandam, vt Ie-suitæ extra regnum abigantur: sed ita vt abactos obdito pessulo reditu prohibeant.

Expulsa autem & expurgata hac acri & ardente bile, Morbi nostratis paroxysmus in genere & paulatim lenietur, reliquæ partes affectæ, Clerus præcipuè, sanabiles & tractabiliores reddentur, poterit q; quod luxatum est, per otium, citra grauiotis alicuius symptomatis metuth[?] curari & restitui.Expulsionis Ie-suitarum qualiter effectus sperandi[?] dus.

Quamdiu verò hic Incendii febrilis fomes intra Reipub: viscera retinebitur; nulla nobis salutis & securitatis spes relinquitur. Quodcunq; enim machinabimur, quibuscunq; emplastris vulnera ligare & obducere studeamus, opera & oleum nobis peribunt, malumq; in hac corporis Polonici Cacochymia ad levissimam quamque occasionem recrudescet: Nequè enim Ie-suitæ, vt cetera omnia sanentur, ad Regni Poloniæ legumq; Polonicarum similaritatem in æternum reducentur, vt illa sub hoc, qui adhuc qualitercunq; durat; sta-tu ꝓrobẽnt.

Ideoq; ne eos quidem audiendos censeo, qui vt res minus[?] odiosa sit, non vniuersalè pur-gationem censent instituendam, sed per partes tantùm bilis istius detractionem & imminu-tionem faciendam putant.Particularis purgatio quo-modo secundum nonnullos instituenda[?]. Verbi gratia, sunt qui eos tantùm extra regnum propellendos existimant, qui vel clandestinarum machinatio-num contra regnum cooperatores aut saltem

page.notes: Scan is slightly skewed and the right-margin notes are partly cut off, so their wording is uncertain and marked [?]. "Expulsionis Ie-suitarum" and "Particularis purgatio" are read from partial letters. The header page number is read as 243 and may be partly obscured. The first line's initial letter looks like "l" but is most likely long s (s) of "sunt", so it is transcribed as "iunt;". "metuth" and "minus" are doubtful readings. The final paragraph continues onto the next page.
